faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about how SkillHub works for freelancers.
faq.a1: SkillHub is a digital marketplace where you can package and sell your freelance skills to clients worldwide.
faq.q2: How do I become a freelancer?
faq.a2: Click 'Start as Freelancer', build your profile, verify your details, and publish your first service package.
faq.q3: Can I create multiple service packages?
faq.a3: Yes, you can publish as many service listings across various categories as your skillset covers.
faq.a4: Clients browse service listings in our catalog and can place orders directly for your gigs.
faq.a5: SkillHub uses a secure Escrow system. Client funds are safely held during order processing and released upon project approval.
faq.q6: How does the rating and review system work?
faq.a6: Upon completion, clients submit star ratings (1-5) and feedback displayed publicly to build your trust score.
